say:1:1732365001:1.text: *Squeak* I grew up here, you know!
say:1:1732365001:1.source_cn: 吱吱，那是因为我可是地地道道的本地老鼠！

say:2:1732365002:1.text: *Squeak* I know all the best food spots around here. I've even explored that alley where no one goes!
say:2:1732365002:1.source_cn: 吱吱，这附近的饭馆厨房哪家好吃，就连那条没有人巷子我也去过！

say:2:1732365002:1.female: *Squeak* I know all the best food spots around here. I've even explored that alley where no one goes!

say:3:1732365003:1.text: *Squeak* That cat's new to the neighborhood. It doesn't stand a chance of catching me!
say:3:1732365003:1.source_cn: 吱吱，不是我说，那只笨猫流浪到这附近才多久，它怎么可能...
